content:
讓我給你一些看法關於這段新的預告, 開發隊以"高動作性遊戲"作為賣點和將幾段大場面的片斷融合一起.
所有場面都是直接從實際遊戲中剪輯出來, 這裡沒有什麼取巧成份等等. 所有畫面都是即時演算. 沒有什麼故事影片過場成份, 意思就是所有所見的都是實時遊戲戰鬥畫面.

預告片最後的部份就是當初一月份舉行的媒體活動時所播出, 若你看近一些, 你會發覺奎爺是在泰坦的手臂上與“Leviathan”的水生物戰鬥, 戰鬥是以一個像偷偷地進行的比率進行中. 我的團隊能完成預告中的戰鬥畫面, 我感到非常自豪. 完全版將會有更多未公開的畫面, 而我更急不及待去看看每一個玩家玩後的想法.

Just to give a little perspective on what we were going for with this trailer, we really wanted to sell the high action of the game and put together snippets of several of the big moments. Everything is pulled straight from the game – there is no trickery, etc. Everything is running in “real time.” There are no “cinematic” sequences here, meaning this is all gameplay.

Towards the end of the trailer we reveal some of the moments from our January media event. If you look closely you can see Kratos on the arm of Gaia fighting against the “Leviathan” water creature, giving a sneak peek of the scale in our game. I am very proud of the work our team has done and how this trailer showcases it.
